curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: match objects with similar attributes in the environment

mission.title: match objects with similar attributes in the environment

interactions.prompt: This red ball needs a friend. Tap the object with the same colour.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the colour of the ball. Find another red object.

interactions.prompt: Match each cup to the cup with the same shape. Tap one, then tap its friend.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object and then tap the object that has the same shape.
interactions.feedback: Great matching! Round goes with round, and tall goes with tall.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the outline. Which two objects have the same shape?

interactions.prompt: Help Amani match each shoe to a shoe of the same size.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a sandal, then tap the shoe that is the same size.
interactions.feedback: Well done! You matched small with small and large with large.
interactions.retryHint: Compare how big each shoe looks before you match it.

interactions.prompt: At the market, match each fruit to the fruit with the same texture.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap one fruit, then tap the fruit that feels the same.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Smooth matches smooth, and rough matches rough.
interactions.retryHint: Think: is the skin smooth or bumpy?

interactions.prompt: In the classroom, match each object to another object used for the same job.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object and then tap its matching classroom friend.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You matched objects that are used in the same way.
interactions.retryHint: Ask yourself: what job does each object do?

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Match the objects that have the same colour, shape, and size.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object, then tap the one that matches all its attributes.
interactions.feedback: Well done! You matched objects by their similar attributes.
interactions.retryHint: Check colour, shape, and size before making each pair.
